decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core portfolio, has its own product page, and fits the firm's automation direction, so the committed investment and visible presentation argue for keeping it.

UV spot varnishing is distant from the core offer, but its home-page prominence is a public commitment to enhancement that management would want to justify, and any weak results can still be blamed on a young market.
The sheet preparation module builds on the established systems and supports the inline automation workflow, so it is integral to the announced direction.
The B2 multifinisher is featured on the home page and is central to the modular, automated finishing strategy, so commitment to it is high.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the core booklet-making business, has its own page, and fits short-run digital workflows.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation that runs creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, a reference that justifies the investment and reinforces commitment.
